fire: The Lorentz factor grows quickly near light speed.
Students derived the Lorentz transformation in class.
A Lorentz curve describes the line shape.
The Lorentz contraction shortens moving rods.
In 1904, Lorentz published his famous equations.
The Lorentz gauge simplifies Maxwell's equations.
Physicists honor Lorentz for his work on electrons.
Each particle feels a Lorentz force in the field.
